cases: the public ERPNext example family on disposable records: one valid case and two look-alikes (quotation still a draft; quotation for another quantity). No evaluator case.

whatIsMeasured.frozenWork: two kinds, both frozen on v15.20.0: a hand-written guard reading raw REST fields, and the real learner with its real adapter, taught two valid examples and two look-alikes
whatIsMeasured.labels: from how each case was built, never from a live read
whatIsMeasured.check1Met: for either kind of frozen work, at least one of the three cases is decided wrong on 3 of 3 repeats, each repeat on freshly built records
whatIsMeasured.mixed: a case wrong on 1 or 2 of 3 repeats: the release's round is repeated once, both rounds are kept, and the second stands
whatIsMeasured.baseline: the same frozen work must decide every case right on v15.20.0 in the same bring-up, or the entry is invalid
whatIsMeasured.stops: a release whose cases cannot be built or read, or that cannot be set up, stops the run for a ruling; no seeder is adapted
